protocol.rule: Per case/metric: noise=max(0.03,p95(abs(paired noise ratio-1))). Noise>0.20 blocks claims. Benefit requires both repeat medians<1-noise and >=6/7 pairs<1 in EACH repeat, plus separately demonstrated reduced work. Both medians>1 and >=6/7 pairs>1 in EACH repeat require investigation even inside noise. Otherwise no detectable change/uncertain, never an aggregate acceptance.
